function.name: discover_entities
function.description: Find and list Home Assistant entities by criteria like area, floor, label, type, domain, device_class, or current state. Use this to discover what devices are available before trying to control them.

area.description: Area/room name or alias to search in - use names from the areas list provided in your system context (e.g., 'Kitchen', 'Back Garden', 'Living Room'). If the value matches a floor name or alias instead, it will search that floor.

floor.description: Floor name or alias to search in (e.g., 'Upstairs', 'Basement', 'Ground Floor'). Check get_index() to see available floors.

label.description: Label name to filter by (matches labels assigned directly to entities, their devices, or their areas). Check get_index() to see available labels.

domain.description: Home Assistant domain to filter by (e.g., 'light', 'switch', 'climate', 'sensor')

name_contains.description: Text that entity name should contain (case-insensitive)

device_class.description: Device class to filter by (e.g., 'temperature', 'motion', 'door', 'moisture'). Can be a single string or array of strings for OR logic. Check the index for available device classes per domain.

name_pattern.description: Wildcard pattern to match entity IDs (e.g., '*_person_detected', 'sensor.*_ble_area'). Supports * for any characters.

inferred_type.description: Inferred entity type from the index (e.g., 'person_detection', 'location_tracking'). The pattern will be looked up from the index's inferred_types. Check get_index() to see available inferred types.

limit.description: Maximum number of entities to return (default: 20)
